ios.desc:
Trace – Your AI Calendar & Daily Planner
Trace is an AI calendar, schedule assistant, and daily planner that helps you organize tasks, routines, and reminders with ease. Type, speak, or capture your schedule—Trace makes planning faster, easier, and smarter.

Key Features
• AI calendar & smart schedule assistant
• Routine planner for daily habits and recurring events
• Reminders, to-do list, checklist, and tracker in one place
• Natural language input: type or speak your schedule
• Voice commands & Siri Shortcuts for hands-free planning
• Screenshot to schedule: create events from images instantly
• iOS widgets for quick glance & task tracking
• iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Manage tasks, events, and routines together

Plan Your Day Smarter

With Trace’s AI planner, you can quickly create events, set multiple reminders, and build daily routines or habits. Plan work meetings, fitness sessions, or personal projects without switching between multiple apps.

All-in-One Productivity

Trace is more than just a calendar—it’s a daily planner, reminder app, and routine tracker combined. Keep tasks, schedules, and events in one place so your day stays clear and focused.

Start simplifying your schedule with Trace today—the smarter, faster, AI-powered calendar and planner app.
